question: Which of the following causative agents causes the disease 'kala-azar'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Protozoa.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Kala Azar, also known as Leishmaniasis, is a parasitic disease caused by protozoa.
 
• The causative agent of kala-azar is Leishmania donovani.
 
• Kala-azar is transmitted through the bite of an infected sandfly.
 
• Scientific name of sandfly is phlebotomus.
 
• Thereby the kala-azar is transmitted by phlebotomus.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png]
